blocks.text: MANILA — Malacañang on Wednesday recognized calls for action against Chinese Ambassador to the Philippines Jing Quan over his controversial remarks but warned that hasty decisions could have repercussions for Filipinos in China. In a Palace press briefing, Presidential Communications Undersecretary Claire Castro said strong reactions from lawmakers and the public were understandable given concerns over Philippine sovereignty and national interests. She assured the public that President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. remains firm in protecting Philippine territory and maritime rights, particularly in the West Philippine Sea. “Ang mga nagbibigay ng ganiyang matatapang na opinion dahil sila ay nakakaramdam ng sakit, pang-iinsulto […]...
